name: ocd_mini_v2
description: Purpose-built Oracle Cross-Dock (OCD) mini-benchmark: 3 protein families × 5 crystal structures each = 60 bidirectional same-protein pairs. Factor Xa (serine protease, Tier-1: same organism), CDK2 (kinase, Tier-1), Thrombin (serine protease, Tier-1). All pairs: same UniProt target, different cognate ligands, sub-2Å cross-dock RMSD achievable (pocket floor < 0.5 Å). Oracle mode: Get_Cleft binding_site.pdb defines search cleft. rmsd_ref_sdf = receptor native ligand (no coordinate frame correction for same-protein). Factor Xa: 1LPZ,1MQ6 from Astex Diverse; 2BOH,2BOK,2P16 downloaded+prepped. CDK2: 1DI8,1E1V,1E9H,1FVT,1OGU downloaded+prepped. Thrombin: 1D3D,1D3P,1DWB,1K21,2ZFF downloaded+prepped.

pairs.note: OCD mini: Factor Xa same-protein cross-dock. oracle_site_pdb = receptor's Get_Cleft cleft. rmsd_ref_sdf = receptor native ligand (same coord frame). No superposition needed for RMSD.
